_comment: USER-EDITABLE limit file, 2026-09-18. The REAL limits live in the CONTROLLERS; this file says what the session-start hook writes into them and what every --execute readback must match. PI values are mm on the C-863.11 (SPA 1 0x15 = TMX high, SPA 1 0x30 = TMN low; RAM only, lost at controller power-cycle - never WPA). ASI values are ABSOLUTE mm (SL = lower, SU = upper; persistent in the ASI controller; never SS Z). 'release' = what `--session end` writes back.
